name: Pulsecraft
probePrompts: What's a free browser-based rhythm trainer for drummers?
A free metronome that works on iPhone without an app?
Where do I get drum patterns I can export as MIDI?
notes: LLM-agnostic. The probe calls OpenAI / Anthropic / Perplexity / Gemini by default — set any of OPENAI_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, PERPLEXITY_API_KEY, GEMINI_API_KEY to enable each. The drafter (used by `mine`) picks the cheapest available LLM: DeepSeek, then Groq, Mistral, OpenRouter, Together, Fireworks, OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini — or a local Ollama when OLLAMA_HOST is set. Override by setting `drafter` to a provider id and `models` per provider.
